| `invalid_transport`             | error    | `/transports`                               | transports must be an object { default, packs, deliverables }.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `invalid_transport`             | error    | `${path}/${outletId}`                       | transports must be one of ${TRANSPORTS.join(", ")}.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `listing_exceeds_model_limit`   | warning  | `${at}/${field}`                            | ${label}.${field} is ${v.length} characters; the listing model allows ${limit}, so it will not be imported as it is. Shorten it to ${limit} or fewer.                                                                                                               |
| `listing_field_conflict`        | error    | `${at}/${alias}`                            | ${label} declares both ${field} and its deprecated alias ${alias}; keep ${field}.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `listing_url_field_deprecated`  | warning  | `${at}/${alias}`                            | ${label}.${alias} is deprecated; write ${field} instead (an https URL or a repo path).                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `outlet_kind_mismatch`          | error    | `/outlets/${id}/kind`                       | outlet ${id} is itself an outlet kind, so its kind may only be ${id} (or omitted); declare another id, such as ${id}-beta, for an outlet of a different kind.                                                                                                       |
| `outlet_without_build`          | warning  | `/outlets/${id}`                            | outlet ${id} (${c.label}) is declared but .pkey/release declares no ${c.platforms.join(" or ")} build in deliverables.app.artifacts, so nothing can ship to it.                                                                                                     |
| `reserved_display_name`         | error    | `/listing/developerName`                    | listing.developerName uses a reserved platform or store name; a developer may not present itself as one. Rename it, or ask the platform operator to approve it.                                                                                                     |
| `reserved_display_name`         | warning  | `/listing/developerName`                    | listing.developerName uses a reserved platform or store name; the sign-in card leaves the developer out instead. This becomes an error once the platform enforces reserved display names.                                                                           |
| `reserved_display_name`         | error    | `/listing/name`                             | listing.name uses a reserved platform or store name; an app may not present itself as one. Rename it, or ask the platform operator to approve it.                                                                                                                   |
| `reserved_display_name`         | warning  | `/listing/name`                             | listing.name uses a reserved platform or store name; the sign-in card shows the product slug instead. This becomes an error once the platform enforces reserved display names.                                                                                      |
| `transport_not_allowed`         | error    | `/transports/default`                       | transports.default applies to every outlet, so it must be a transport any outlet can carry (pkey-cdn or embedded).                                                                                                                                                  |
| `transport_not_allowed`         | error    | `${path}/${outletId}`                       | transport ${transport} cannot carry a deliverable on a ${kind} outlet.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `unknown_artifact_ref`          | error    | `/outlets/${id}/artifact`                   | outlets.${id}.artifact must name an id in .pkey/release deliverables.app.artifacts.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `unknown_channel_ref`           | error    | `/outlets/${id}/${field}/${channel}`        | outlets.${id}.${field} keys must be declared channels (stable, beta, dev, a manual channel or one of deliverables.app.channels).                                                                                                                                    |
| `unknown_deliverable_ref`       | error    | `/outlets/${id}/depots/${packId}`           | outlets.${id}.depots keys must name a pack deliverable declared in .pkey/release.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `unknown_deliverable_ref`       | error    | `/transports/deliverables/${deliverableId}` | transports.deliverables keys must name a deliverable declared in .pkey/release (app is always declared).                                                                                                                                                            |
| `unknown_outlet_kind`           | error    | `/outlets/${id}/kind`                       | outlet ${id} needs a kind from ${OUTLET_KINDS.join(", ")} (an outlet id that is itself a kind may omit it).                                                                                                                                                         |
| `unknown_outlet_ref`            | error    | `${path}/${outletId}`                       | transport maps may only name outlets declared under outlets.                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `value_not_representable`       | error    | `${distributionIssue.path \|\| "/"}`        | This value cannot be carried by a signed document (${distributionIssue.rule}): a lone surrogate, U+0000 in a member name, two sibling member names equal after NFC normalization, a number outside 1e-307 to 1e308 in magnitude, or more than 32 levels of nesting. |
